cursor.label: Cursor
cursor.body:
---
description: Senior-first, WCAG-minded UI rules for this project (A11yKit)
globs: ["**/*.html", "**/*.css", "**/*.js", "**/*.jsx", "**/*.tsx", "**/*.vue"]
alwaysApply: true
---

# Senior-first UI rules

Apply these rules to every UI change in this project. They come from A11yKit, a
component kit built for 70-year-old hands and low-vision eyes. Do not restyle the
project to match a trend; match these constraints.

## 1. Targets and focus
- Interactive elements are at least 48x48 CSS px; primary actions 56-64px tall.
- 12px or more between adjacent targets. Never place two actions closer than 8px.
- Grow the hit area with padding, not transform: scale().
- Focus ring: 4px solid #FFE066, 3px offset, :focus-visible only, never clipped by
  overflow:hidden. Keyboard order follows visual order.

## 2. Text and contrast
- Body text at least 7:1 contrast (WCAG AAA). Reference pair: #F3F6F9 on #06090F = 18.4:1.
- Secondary text at least 4.5:1; aim for 7:1.
- Base font 19px, line-height 1.6, no justified text, about 72ch per line maximum.
- Korean: word-break: keep-all. Use overflow-wrap: anywhere only for URLs and codes.
- Survive 200% browser zoom and a 320px viewport: no horizontal scroll, no clipped text.
- Never signal state with colour alone: add an icon, a word, weight or underline.

## 3. Semantics and announcements
- Use real <button>, <a>, <input>, <select>, <dialog>. A div with a click handler is a bug.
- Labels sit above the field and are tied with for/id. A placeholder is never the label.
- Every status change writes into an existing role="status" aria-live="polite" element.
  Errors (and only errors) use role="alert".
- Groups of choices use fieldset/legend or role="radiogroup" with aria-checked and
  roving tabindex (one tab stop, arrows move).
- Dialogs use <dialog>.showModal(), trap nothing by hand, close on Escape, and return
  focus to the trigger.
- Expose state with aria-pressed / aria-checked / aria-current / aria-expanded, not with
  a CSS class alone.

## 4. Sound and motion (optional, never required)
- If sound is added, synthesize it with Web Audio inside the user's gesture. No audio
  files, at most one tone per 80ms, and a mute switch whose choice persists.
- Every sound cue is mirrored by visible text and a live-region announcement.
- Respect prefers-reduced-motion: no transforms, autoplay, parallax or marquee.
- Reserve space (min-height) so a status message never shifts the layout.

## 5. Code shape
- Ship plain HTML, CSS and one vanilla JS block per component unless the project already
  has a framework. No CDN, no tracking script, no telemetry, no external requests.
- Colours and spacing come from CSS custom properties; no repeated magic numbers.
- Prefer native elements over ARIA. ARIA only fills gaps native HTML cannot.

## 6. Before you say it is done
- Tab through the whole flow: every control reachable and operable with the keyboard only.
- Screen-reader pass: name, role, state and live announcements all present.
- 200% zoom and 320px width: no horizontal scroll, nothing clipped.
- Measure contrast for each text/background pair you introduced.
- Zero console errors and zero failed network requests.
- Name the A11yKit component ids you reused (list_components, get_component via MCP).

Full component index: https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/a11y-ui-kit/llms.txt

claude-code.body:
# CLAUDE.md - senior-first UI rules (A11yKit)

This project targets older and low-vision users. Follow these rules for every UI
change; they override stylistic defaults and library conventions.

## Targets and focus
- Interactive elements >= 48x48 CSS px, primary actions 56-64px tall, >= 12px gaps.
- Focus: 4px solid #FFE066 ring, 3px offset, :focus-visible only, never clipped.
- Keyboard order = visual order. No keyboard traps, no focus loss on close.

## Text and contrast
- Body text >= 7:1 contrast (AAA); reference #F3F6F9 on #06090F = 18.4:1.
- Secondary text >= 4.5:1. Base font 19px, line-height 1.6, <= ~72ch per line.
- Korean: word-break: keep-all. Survive 200% zoom and 320px width with no horizontal scroll.
- State is never colour-only: pair colour with icon, word, weight or underline.

## Semantics
- Real button/a/input/dialog; visible label above each field tied with for/id.
- role="status" aria-live="polite" for status, role="alert" only for errors.
- Radio groups: fieldset/legend or role="radiogroup" + aria-checked + roving tabindex.
- <dialog>.showModal() for modals; Escape closes; focus returns to trigger.
- aria-pressed / aria-checked / aria-current / aria-expanded expose state.

## Sound and motion
- Optional Web Audio tones only (no files, <= 1 per 80ms) with a persistent mute switch,
  always mirrored in visible text and the live region.
- Honour prefers-reduced-motion. Reserve space so messages never shift layout.

## Code
- Plain HTML + CSS + one vanilla JS block unless the project already uses a framework.
- No CDN, no telemetry, no external requests. CSS custom properties for colour/spacing.

## Done means
- Full keyboard walkthrough, screen-reader pass, 200% zoom and 320px check, contrast
  measured, zero console errors, zero failed requests.
- List the A11yKit component ids reused. If you need the exact source, ask for it with
  the a11y-kit MCP tools (list_components, get_component, get_ai_prompt,
  check_wcag_checklist) instead of inventing markup.

Component index: https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/a11y-ui-kit/llms.txt

# .windsurfrules - senior-first UI (A11yKit)

Scope: every HTML, CSS and JS file in this workspace. These rules win over style
preferences and library defaults.

- Targets: interactive elements >= 48x48 CSS px (56-64px for primary actions), >= 12px
  between neighbours. Padding grows the hit area, never transform: scale().
- Focus: 4px #FFE066 ring with 3px offset, :focus-visible only, never clipped.
- Contrast: body text >= 7:1 (AAA), secondary >= 4.5:1. Base 19px / 1.6, <= ~72ch.
- Korean text: word-break: keep-all; no mid-word breaks.
- Layout: correct at 200% zoom and 320px width, no horizontal scroll, no clipped text.
- State is never colour-only: icon, word, weight or underline always accompany colour.
- Native semantics first: button, a, input, select, dialog; labels above fields, tied by
  for/id. Placeholders are never labels.
- Live regions: role="status" aria-live="polite" for status, role="alert" for errors.
- Radio groups: fieldset/legend or role="radiogroup" with aria-checked and roving tabindex.
- Modals: <dialog>.showModal(), Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger.
- State via aria-pressed / aria-checked / aria-current / aria-expanded, not classes alone.
- Sound only as optional Web Audio tones synthesised in the gesture (no files, <= 1 per
  80ms), with a persistent mute switch and the same message in visible text.
- Honour prefers-reduced-motion; reserve min-height so messages do not shift layout.
- Ship plain HTML + CSS + one vanilla JS block; no CDN, no tracking, no external requests.
- Finish with: keyboard-only walkthrough, screen-reader pass, 200% zoom and 320px check,
  measured contrast, zero console errors, and a list of A11yKit component ids reused.

Component index and copy-ready source: https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/a11y-ui-kit/llms.txt

copilot.label: GitHub Copilot
copilot.body:
# Copilot instructions - senior-first UI (A11yKit)

This repository builds interfaces for older and low-vision users. Apply these rules to
every suggestion you make for HTML, CSS, JS and component code.

## Non-negotiables
1. Touch and click targets >= 48x48 CSS px; primary actions 56-64px; >= 12px gaps.
2. Focus ring 4px #FFE066, 3px offset, :focus-visible only, never clipped.
3. Body text contrast >= 7:1 (AAA). Reference: #F3F6F9 on #06090F = 18.4:1.
4. Base font 19px, line-height 1.6, line length <= ~72ch, no justified text.
5. Korean: word-break: keep-all.
6. State never conveyed by colour alone - add icon, word, weight or underline.
7. Real semantic elements; visible label above every field, tied with for/id.
8. role="status" aria-live="polite" for status changes; role="alert" only for errors.
9. Dialogs are <dialog>.showModal(); Escape closes; focus returns to the trigger.
10. Works at 200% zoom and 320px width with no horizontal scroll.

## Avoid
- div or span as a button, placeholder-only labels, hidden focus outlines.
- Colour-only success/error/selected states, animated transitions that ignore
  prefers-reduced-motion, layout shifts when a message appears.
- Audio files, CDN scripts, trackers, external font or icon requests.
- Inventing component markup: reuse the A11yKit ids instead.

## Done means
Keyboard-only walkthrough, screen-reader pass, 200% zoom and 320px check, contrast
measured, zero console errors, and the list of A11yKit component ids reused.

Component index: https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/a11y-ui-kit/llms.txt

agents.body:
# AGENTS.md - senior-first UI rules (A11yKit)

Applies to any coding agent working in this repository: Codex, Gemini CLI, Cline, Zed,
Devin, or a custom runner. Read this before editing UI files.

## Constraints
- Targets >= 48x48 CSS px (56-64px primary), >= 12px apart, no scale() hit areas.
- Focus ring 4px #FFE066 with 3px offset on :focus-visible, never clipped.
- Body text >= 7:1 contrast; secondary >= 4.5:1; 19px base, 1.6 line-height, <= ~72ch.
- Korean: word-break: keep-all. No mid-word breaks, no justified text.
- 200% zoom and 320px width must stay usable without horizontal scrolling.
- Colour is never the only state signal.
- Semantic HTML first; labels above fields tied with for/id; no placeholder-only labels.
- Status via role="status" aria-live="polite"; errors via role="alert".
- Choice groups: fieldset/legend or role="radiogroup" + aria-checked + roving tabindex.
- Modals: <dialog>.showModal(), Escape closes, focus returns to the trigger.
- Optional sound: Web Audio tones only, mute switch persisted, mirrored in text.
- prefers-reduced-motion respected; no layout shift when messages appear.
- Plain HTML + CSS + one vanilla JS block; no CDN, no tracker, no external request.

## Verify before finishing
1. Keyboard-only walkthrough of the whole flow.
2. Screen reader: names, roles, states, announcements.
3. 200% zoom, 320px width: no horizontal scroll.
4. Contrast measured per text/background pair.
5. Zero console errors, zero failed requests.
6. Report the A11yKit component ids reused.

If you need exact source or a WCAG checklist, use the a11y-kit MCP server:
list_components, get_component, get_ai_prompt, check_wcag_checklist.
Index: https://doggonug-cpu.github.io/a11y-ui-kit/llms.txt
